product_metadata.title: Lush Decor Julia Stripe Curtains | Room Darkening Striped Window Panel Set for Living, Dining, Bedroom (Pair), 84” x 52”, Gray
features: Lush Décor Julia Stripe curtain panels feature a classic, vertical stripe design for your traditional or modern style bedroom, living room or dining room windows.
2 panel curtain set made of 100% polyester fabric. Each panel measures 84”H x 52”W and are not lined.
These stripe curtains have a 3” back tab rod pocket for easy installation options.
Room darkening window curtains filter a portion of light and heat, but allow for some natural light to come through.
Easy to care for and safe to machine wash cold, gentle cycle and tumble dry low. Do not wring.
description: Enhance your decor with these modern stripe pattern blackout curtains. The energy efficient panels block sunlight and feature a modern vertical striped pattern with thin stripes between wider stripes. The look would fit perfectly in any room of the home.
